taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from Nerve and Muscle Physiology (PY3.1-3.2).

words.clue: The main body of a neuron containing the nucleus and metabolic machinery
The single long process that conducts the action potential away from the cell body
Short branching processes that receive signals from other neurons
The trigger zone on the axon where action potentials are initiated
The cell type that myelinates a single internode in the peripheral nervous system
The most common neuron type having one axon and many dendrites
A glial cell that maintains the blood-brain barrier and regulates ion concentrations
The immune cells of the central nervous system
The equation used to calculate the equilibrium voltage for an ion across the membrane
The voltage difference across the cell membrane that is typically about negative seventy millivolts
